latest.title: Dimensional reduction associated with unchanged direction trajectories in flat fiber Robertson Walker spacetimes
latest.abstract: In this article, we establish a new dimensional reduction result in (Galilean or Lorentzian) Robertson Walker spacetimes with Euclidean fiber. In this context, we prove that every unchanged direction observer can be embedded into a three dimensional totally geodesic timelike submanifold.
latest.workSummary: 证明平坦纤维 Robertson--Walker 时空中的 unchanged-direction 观察者可嵌入三维全测地类时子流形。
latest.breakthrough: 把一类观察者轨迹的动力学问题降维到三维全测地背景。
latest.limitations: 结论依赖欧氏纤维和特定轨迹条件，主要服务于数学相对论。
latest.priorityReason: 按相关性、新颖性、技术复用性、潜在影响与证据清晰度综合评分为 52/100。
